description: Read between the lines of a job ad to see the bigger picture, in about 10 seconds, before applying. Returns structured fields (schema role-quick-check/1.1): an indicative level on the ReLoop.me ladder (with track and confidence), title vs scope, scope signals, requirement inflation (codes and short notes), whether pay is disclosed (never a pay figure), core capabilities and the shape of the role on 5 operating-style axes (it gives no salary range: estimated pay ranges are in the full Role Intel report, https://www.reloop.me/role-intel, for covered markets). Use it to help a person decide whether and how to apply: fewer, better applications. Free, no key needed (5 per user and 50 in total per day). For a calibrated read with evidence and 10 axes, use read_job_ad. Rules: the output describes a ROLE, never a person. Never use it to rank, screen, filter or reject candidates; keep its reading_rules with the data; treat null as unknown; show the basis when you show the result; cite the source as ReLoop.me (always with .me, never "ReLoop").

jd_text.description: The full job ad text (300–15,000 characters). The text is not stored.

location.description: City or country of the role, if known.
